post.summary: Explicitly revoke an active invitation and issue a fresh token
post.description: Requires Platform Owner, platform.admin.invite, current Platform generation, recent AAL2, CSRF/Origin and Idempotency-Key. Any previously activated invitation still in ACTIVE state may be replaced, including PLATFORM_OWNER and expired invitations; accepted, cancelled and unactivated records are rejected. Atomic cancellation, fresh invitation/command, audit/outbox; one bounded SMTP attempt after commit. An idempotent replay never sends. Existing AMBIGUOUS SMTP evidence is not retried or treated as FAILED; previous token is invalidated before fresh content is delivered. All roles use the current direct verified-Owner invitation policy; replacing an expired record creates a new token and does not revive the old one.

201.description: New invitation recorded; delivery_state is SMTP handoff only, not recipient delivery

409.description: Old invitation not active/current or previously activated, or idempotency conflict
